summary_1line: Yudhishthira rules prosperously at Indraprastha; Arjuna and Krishna go to the Yamuna for leisure where a radiant Brahmana unexpectedly approaches them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna and Arjuna sit on ornate seats in a forest grove by the Yamuna as a radiant Brahmana with matted locks and golden complexion approaches them.
At the riverside pavilions, women dance, sing, and play in the woods and water while Draupadi and Subhadra distribute robes and ornaments.
Yudhishthira sits enthroned at Indraprastha with his four brothers beside him, resembling a great sacrifice supported by the four Vedas.
